name: admin_provider
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Provider — a registered cloud, Kubernetes, source-control, or observability provider (with its authentication credentials) that scopes and agents use.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the provider.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Provider type (case-insensitive). One of: eks, aks, gke, rhos, otel, aws, azure, gcp, datadog, newrelic, sentry, grafanaalertmanager, pagerduty, incident.io, github, gitlab, bitbucket, apollo, outreach, zoom, attention, gong, hubspot, salesforce, marketo, mailchimp, vanta, drata, other.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Provider category. Defaults to 'cloud'.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Account identifier for the provider (e.g. an AWS account id or cluster endpoint).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the provider.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Free-form key/value metadata.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the provider is active. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: credentials
attributes.description: Authentication credentials for the provider. Sensitive field values are write-only: the API redacts them on read, so Terraform keeps the configured value in state and cannot detect an out-of-band change to a secret.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the credential.

attributes.name: credential_fields
attributes.description: Key/value credential fields (e.g. accessKeyId, password, iamRoleArn).

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Field name (e.g. accessKeyId, password, iamRoleArn).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Field value. Sensitive — redacted in plan output, and write-only: the API never returns it, so the configured value is kept in state.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Field type (e.g. 'string', 'secret').

attributes.name: is_sensitive
attributes.description: Whether this field is sensitive. The server may auto-promote known secret keys (e.g. password, apikey).

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Free-form key/value metadata for this credential.

attributes.name: system_credential
attributes.description: System credential for the provider. Sensitive field values are write-only: the API redacts them on read, so Terraform keeps the configured value in state.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the system credential.

attributes.name: credential_fields
attributes.description: Key/value credential fields.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Field value. Sensitive — redacted in plan output, and write-only: the API never returns it, so the configured value is kept in state.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Field type (e.g. 'string', 'secret').

attributes.name: is_sensitive
attributes.description: Whether this field is sensitive.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Free-form key/value metadata for the system credential.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the provider was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the provider was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
